Fail-safe: with no rows the arbiter's Tier-1 flow retrieval returns empty so a `workflow` modality is never nearest-neighbour-selected — flows revert to explicit-id-only selection (pre-0316 behaviour). No money/licence/ledger records; rails unaffected. Dev/staging rollback only.

Drops the platform_llm_routing_config table (the LLM control-plane store: one JSONB config doc per scope — coreModel + orderedFallbacks[] + ensemble{members,combineStrategy,judgeModel} + perUseCase map — behind a service-role-only FORCE RLS policy + guarded anon REVOKE). Fail-safe: with no rows the router consumption layer treats config as absent and falls back to the static TASK_LADDER (pre-control-plane behaviour), so no turn breaks. POWERS/kill-switch flags live in platform_feature_flags and are untouched. No money/licence/ledger records; sovereign HITL rails live in the policy-gate, not here. Dev/staging rollback only.

Drops the md_commitments table (the MD deferral/follow-through commitment ledger — the brain's prospective-memory backlog: GTD class discriminator + typed WAIT-FOR trigger (time|event|condition) + honest lifecycle + ladder rung + sovereign safe-halt flag + evidence ids + hash-chained closure, behind FORCE RLS tenant-isolation/service-role-bypass policies + guarded anon REVOKE). Fail-safe: with no table the EstateMind RECONCILE sweep treats the backlog as empty (the reconcile port is fail-safe — a store fault never breaks the tick) and reverts to pre-deferral behaviour. No money/licence/ledger records; sovereign HITL rails live in the policy-gate + mwikila_actions_inbox, not here. Dev/staging rollback only.
